testcase.name: Scenario: Reverse the size sort without losing the selected file: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-opening-source/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:99:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reverse the size sort without losing the selected file ✔ Given the Open dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the detailed file list contains files of different sizes ✔ And OpenSortLarge.opd is selected with its file name and preview displayed ✔ And the file list is sorted by decreasing size ✔ And `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenSortSmall.opd`, `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenSortMedium.opd`, and `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenSortLarge.opd` are visible with distinct sizes ✔ When the user clicks the Size column header ✔ Then the file list is sorted by increasing size ✔ And the selected part remains selected with its file name and preview displayed
